b/table.patch

@@ -0,0 +1,2048 @@
+From 4a7d17209a24336d6ce887f7ec7686e4ee6ed358 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: Tamal <tasaha@habana.ai>
+Date: Sat, 23 Mar 2024 09:35:39 +0200
+Subject: [PATCH] script file to genearate mbist table txt file for
+
+ppboot image
+
+how to use
+eg:
+$cd /home/<user-id>/trees/npu-stack/embedded/buildroot-external
+$gcc mbist_table.c
+$./a.out > board/habanalabs/gaudi3_arc/die_sram_mbist_data.txt
+
+update "mem_MemoryBist_and_softRepair_ppboot_modified" array
+in mbist_table.c file if required for trial/experiment.
+
+die_sram_mbist_data.txt file will be used internally for
+image generation
+
+Change-Id: I71ff44b22d31c708e63eccc2a88a237fb518934c
+Signed-off-by: Tamal <tasaha@habana.ai>
+---
+ mbist_table.c | 2013 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
+ 1 file changed, 2013 insertions(+)
+ create mode 100644 mbist_table.c
+
+diff --git a/mbist_table.c b/mbist_table.c
+new file mode 100644
+index 00000000..4f122d9b
+--- /dev/null

b/mbist_table.c
+@@ -0,0 +1,2013 @@
++
